texts.title: Weekend Pottery Workshops at Harbor Arts Studio
texts.content:
Four-week course begins Saturday, March 8
No experience necessary — all materials included
Small groups of eight students or fewer
Register by March 1 at www.harborarts.example.com

questions.stem: What is indicated about the workshops?
options: A. Participants must bring their own clay.
B. They are designed for experienced potters.
C. Class sizes are kept small.
D. They meet on weekday evenings.
questions.explanation: The advertisement says the course has 'small groups of eight students or fewer.' Materials are included, beginners are welcome, and classes are on weekends.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the advertisement?
options: A. To announce a change to an existing course
B. To attract people to sign up for a class
C. To thank students for completing a workshop
D. To request volunteers for an art studio
questions.explanation: It describes a new course, highlights its benefits, and tells readers how and when to register, so its purpose is to attract new participants.
